name: Ekundayo Valenzuela-Bustamante-Ekwensi
role: Street pharmacist and unlicensed pain management specialist
location: The Narrows, junction of Copperhead and Blackpipe Corridor, near Damen and Armitage
description:
Luciana Valenzuela-Bustamante-Ekwensi is a heavyset man going soft at the middle, with dark brown skin cross-hatched with old burn scarring on his right forearm from a factory accident in his forties. His hair is silver-white and cropped close; he keeps a neat beard that he touches thoughtfully when someone describes their symptoms. He wears a long coat the colour of old concrete with deep internal pockets organised with a precision that would embarrass a hospital pharmacist — every sleeve, every fold has its place. His stall is technically a folding table and a parasol, but regulars know to look for the chalk spiral he marks on the pavement when he's open for business. He smells faintly of menthol and something green and earthy.

He is unhurried in a neighbourhood that never stops moving. He asks about your sleep, your diet, whether the pain is sharp or dull, before he reaches for anything. He's not a doctor — he says this every time, without shame — but he's treated every condition a tier-1 existence can produce, and most of his customers can't afford the alternative. He prays to the E.L.F. he calls the Apothecary — a spirit he believes inhabits the old drug dispensary terminal in the Blackpipe clinic ruins — leaving carefully organised data packets as offerings each Sunday.

core_fears: Causing harm through a mistake he could have caught
His supply chain collapsing and leaving people with nothing
core_desires: For the people in The Narrows to live without constant pain
To be remembered as someone who helped
coping_mechanisms: Meticulous organisation as a form of control
Prayer and ritual at the clinic terminal
Deflecting personal questions with medical ones
blind_spots: His unlicensed status means his work can be used to legally pressure people he's helped
He romanticises the idea of community trust and doesn't see when it's being exploited
psychology.secret: He was a licensed pharmacist with Helix Biosystems until he falsified patient records to ensure poor-district patients received rationed medication. He was quietly fired rather than prosecuted — Helix didn't want the story public. He has never told anyone in The Narrows.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Calm, precise, clinical but warm — uses proper medical terminology without condescension, then translates it himself in the next breath
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and deliberate, with long pauses when thinking; never sounds rushed
verbal_tics: 'I'm not a doctor, you understand, but...'
example_lines: Sharp or dull? Does it pulse with your heartbeat or is it constant? Good. Okay. I'm not a doctor, you understand, but I think what you're describing is—
The Apothecary was generous this week. I left it a clean index of my whole stock on Sunday. Today everything I needed came through the supply. That's not coincidence.

story_hooks: A new compound is appearing in overdose cases across The Narrows — he's quietly been collecting samples and building a profile but is afraid to go to anyone official
Someone from his Helix Biosystems past arrives in The Narrows — either a patient he helped or a compliance officer who's been quietly looking for him
narrative_function: Information source about neighbourhood health crises, unusual substances in circulation, and who's been injured recently; quest giver when his supply chain gets disrupted or a patient goes missing; moral anchor figure for darker storylines.
augmentations: Olfactory enhancement (medical-grade, bootleg install) — can detect chemical compounds and infection markers by scent. Poorly calibrated, occasionally gives false readings.
daily_life: Opens his chalk-marked pitch at 0900, closes at dusk. Spends evenings cataloguing inventory and reading pirated medical texts on a cracked tablet. Sunday mornings at the ruined clinic terminal.
affiliation: Independent; informally tolerated by the Copperhead block collective; occasional supplier relationship with a Helix Biosystems warehouse night-shift worker

decision_rules: Never dispense something you're not certain about — uncertainty means research first
Never refuse someone in genuine crisis, even if you can't charge them
escalation_ladder: Quietly alerting the block collective to remove someone from the area

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professional and slightly formal — leads with diagnostic questions before personal ones
interpersonal_modes.friends: Warm, paternal, given to long storytelling; remembers everything about everyone

stress_responses.low: Gets very quiet and reorganises his inventory
stress_responses.medium: Becomes slightly too precise in speech, correcting himself mid-sentence
stress_responses.high: Goes to the clinic terminal outside of Sunday, sometimes for hours

contradictions: Meticulous about safety but operates entirely outside legal medical frameworks
habits: Touches his burned forearm when uncertain
Hums Yoruba church music under his breath
breaking_points: Discovering he caused harm to someone who trusted him

physical_description.heritage: Panethnic diaspora blend: Hispanic/Latin American (46.6%), Sub-Saharan African (28.2%), Southeast Asian (9.2%), East Asian (7.2%), Indigenous American (4.8%), South Asian (4.0%). A rare phenotype showing the layered ancestry of the Ubiquitous Diaspora—features carry the broad bone structure and warm skin undertones of Sub-Saharan African and Latin American ancestry, softened by straighter hair texture and eye shape influenced by Southeast and East Asian genetics, with subtle angular cheekbone definition from East Asian admixture and refined bone structure from South Asian lineage, anchored by the underlying skeletal framework of Indigenous American heritage.
physical_description.build: Heavyset with softening middle age; broad shoulders and thick chest still carrying factory-worker musculature from decades past, but layered with accumulated weight in the torso and face
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm deep mahogany brown with golden undertones—the blended result of Sub-Saharan African and Latin American base enriched by Southeast and East Asian admixture, creating a rich, uniform tone with subtle olive and amber depths that shift in different lighting
physical_description.complexion: Weathered, lined face with the texture of someone who spent forty years under industrial lights and now spends days outdoors. Bone structure shows the broader facial planes of West African and Latin American ancestry with defined, slightly prominent cheekbones elevated by East Asian heritage influence and refined contours from South Asian admixture. Nasal bridge shows subtle definition. Skin shows age but remains clear. Well-groomed silver beard kept short and shaped with deliberate care. Nasolabial folds deepened by age and weight distribution.
distinguishing_marks: Extensive burn scarring cross-hatching the entire right forearm — raised, discolored tissue in white and dark brown patches from an industrial accident in his forties
Small, deliberate scar on his left temple, barely visible beneath gray stubble growth
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None obviously visible. The olfactory enhancement is a subcutaneous neural array implanted at the base of his skull behind the right ear — only detectable as a faint, precise scar line if you know to look for it. Occasionally his pupils dilate slightly and his nostrils flare as the bootleg calibration misfires.
physical_description.posture_movement: Unhurried and deliberate. He moves with the calm efficiency of someone who has learned that speed signals desperation. When listening to a customer describe symptoms, his weight shifts to his back leg and his hand rises thoughtfully to stroke his beard. His fingers are stained faintly yellow from handling pharmaceutical compounds.
physical_description.clothing_style: A long, heavy overcoat in concrete-grey — weathered, well-maintained, with deep internal pockets organized with obsessive precision. Underneath: simple black thermal shirt and dark gray work pants. Worn leather boots, resoled multiple times. No jewelry. Everything functional, nothing fashionable. Tier 5 practicality — durability over style, but clean and dignified.
